approval: Dan Brennan approved the 114-placement final Mark 4 shot map as drafted on 2026-10-25. The original final-picture frames remain the visual authority.

imports.action: The clean lake establishing picture continues after the localized chapter title.
An empty boat rests beside the shore before Jesus teaches the crowd.
The shore crowd watches Jesus seated in the boat.
Jesus addresses the gathered shore crowd from the boat in a wide view.
A second slow view moves toward Jesus in the boat as the crowd listens.
Young shoots in good soil illustrate the seed yielding a crop.
Jesus closes the sower teaching from the boat before the crowd.
Disciples listen during the private exchange about the parables.
Two disciples listen as Jesus explains the sower parable.
A group of listeners considers Jesus's instruction to pay attention to what they hear.
A listener in the shore crowd considers the mustard-seed comparison.
Two disciples listen after Jesus speaks in parables to the crowd.
Two disciples listen before Jesus explains privately to his followers.
The calm night sea pulls away from the boat after the disciples' final question.
